title: TIC monthly release (March 2027 data) — a pure ORDINARY edition, the control class the revision dispute actually turns on, 4:00 p.m. ET
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,181 bytes) by the tic-monthly-2027-04-15 initial research — its 2027 table's May row reads '18' in the Monthly column with BOTH quarterly columns and BOTH annual columns EMPTY, under the page header 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time'. A single-cut monthly release. Reference month March 2027 by the page's own 1.5-month lag rule. Corroborated mechanically: the 11th business day of May 2027 is 2027-05-17 (Monday), putting the published 2027-05-18 at offset +1 business day, inside the page's '11th business day plus 0 to 3 days' rule. May 2027's only 5 U.S.C. 6103 federal holiday is Memorial Day 2027-05-31, which falls after the 11th business day and therefore moves nothing — so like April this date discriminates nothing between the holiday-aware and holiday-blind conventions, and that is stated rather than smoothed. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep: the proposer may not confirm what it found, only the event's own session may. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-monthly-2027-04-15 initial research (2026-09-09), the next unclaimed monthly slot after 2027-04-15. IT SITS ON THE AXIS THE DISPUTE IS ACTUALLY ABOUT. FT-tic-monthly-2027-01-19-3's revision-edition effect turns entirely on its CONTROL class: the treatment mean is $5.01bn in both of the sibling's printed readings, and the post-hoc Feb/Mar exclusion moves only the ordinary mean ($4.46bn with them in, p=0.78; $1.67bn with them out, p<0.001). Every excluded vintage is control-class, because February and March are never Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct editions. May 2027 is a PURE ordinary edition — neither a note (c) revision month, nor a quarterly-cut month (the quarterly columns are filled in March, June, September and December), nor a February or March vintage. That makes it a cleaner control observation than the Jun/Sep/Dec editions FT-tic-monthly-2027-03-18-2 already watches, which carry the quarterly nonfinancial/derivatives cut as a confound. ITS CORRIDOR IS ALSO CLEAN, though less so than April's. The next FOMC decision after 2027-05-18 is 2027-06-09, twenty-two days out; the scored session 2027-05-19 is a Wednesday, and May 2027's opex is 2027-05-21, so the scored session carries no expiration either. Measured on the same computation that found April's +12 to +21: the May TIC release has stood +26 to +35 calendar days before the following FOMC decision in every year 2014-2026, and 2027's +22 is the tightest on that fourteen-year record — still far outside any contamination window. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds (16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is six weeks stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed). Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
